# Madden — *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic* (G4)

Madden is the shades-wearing blue-gray pegasus who serves as the booming, headset-equipped announcer at Cloudsdale’s Best Young Flyer Competition in **“Sonic Rainboom” (S1E16)**. He is memorable for presenting Princess Celestia and the Wonderbolts while Rainbow Dash anxiously waits to compete.

**Appearance.** Pale blue-gray coat, swept white-and-pale-blue mane and tail, oversized dark sunglasses, black jacket with white trim and gold clasp, and a microphone headset. His cutie mark is concealed by his clothing.

**Name and continuity.** The character appears in the G4 television episode without anyone saying his name. “Madden” circulated as a fan/identification name and subsequently appeared in the officially licensed *The Wonderbolts Academy Handbook* (2016), making it an official companion-book name, not spoken television dialogue. Gameloft’s mobile game uses **“Announcer Pony”** instead. The G4 [pegasus character register](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Pegasus_ponies) records these distinctions; a [handbook reader’s account](https://www.fimfiction.net/blog/1057019/friendship-is-card-games-the-wonderbolts-academy-handbook) independently confirms the printed name. No separate alter ego or disguise is established.

**Speaking and appearances.** Madden **speaks** in S1E16, voiced by **Richard Ian Cox** ([episode voice credits](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt1850770/fullcredits/)). His announcements are recorded in the [episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Sonic_Rainboom). His known on-screen role is this competition; the character register also notes a reference on the regular cover of IDW’s *Friends Forever* #18, not a verified story appearance.

Additional [Wonderbolts race fan artwork featuring Madden](https://twibooru.org/12467) is tagged to artist **Hinoraito** on its image page.

## Important moments

- **Welcoming the guests — “Sonic Rainboom” (S1E16):** Madden formally introduces Princess Celestia and the Wonderbolts as celebrity judges, setting up the contest at the heart of Rainbow Dash’s ambition. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l82yvb2_gqk) — precise scene timestamp unavailable.
- **Introducing the unusual final flight — “Sonic Rainboom” (S1E16):** He announces contestant #15 and awkwardly acknowledges Rarity joining the same flight, immediately before the performance turns into Rainbow Dash’s spectacular rescue. [Official episode in compilation](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nbAjaIeGsrE) — precise scene timestamp unavailable.
